## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, what changed, and the outcome for the user.

## Validation

Include the commands you ran and any relevant limitations. For changes to
release contents, also build and test the exported source tree.

## Data and execution boundaries

Identify any new data source, fixture or dependency and its provenance. Keep
credentials and private reports out of the diff. Preserve completed-bar
causality, explicit source/cutoff reporting and the paper-only boundary.
